messages:
Jamie: Heads-up: PR 5701 preview is showing dashboard embeds as raw JSON code blocks and one of the gallery screenshots is 404. Also spotted multiple SDK snippets still using `trace_id` or `traceid`. I'm going to hold the PR until we have a quick remediation plan.
Lee: Can you paste the netlify link or logs? I couldn't repro locally with mkdocs.
Jamie: Netlify preview failed with: deploy 34220 -> AttributeRemoved: data-widget-id. Logs: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/34220/logs
deploy-bot: PR 5701 branch 'docs/console-ci-fix' preview deploy failed: 422 AttributeRemoved: data-widget-id removed by sanitizer.
Priya: Sounds like the sanitizer allowlist dropped `data-widget-*`. Proposal: (1) revert the sanitizer bump on the preview branch to restore previews; (2) add an mkdocs config allowlist for `data-widget-id` and `data-src`; (3) add a docs-lint action to validate image refs exist and warn on underscores in filenames.
Omar: I'll take the docs-lint GH Action. It should: parse markdown for image refs, verify files exist under docs/assets/, and optionally warn if filenames contain underscores. I'll open infra PR today.
Mei: I'll sweep SDK snippets and update examples to `trace_id_hex` across JS/Python/Go and add a 1-line migration note at the top of tracing.md. Tiny diff I'll include in the PR:```diff
- await client.trace({ trace_id: 'abcd' })
+ await client.trace({ trace_id_hex: '0xabcd' })
```
Jamie: Plan: 1) revert preview-only sanitizer bump on PR 5701 (Jamie) so others can iterate; 2) Omar lands docs-lint action (infra) as a non-blocking warning first; 3) Priya adds mkdocs allowlist patch and tests locally; 4) Mei opens SDK snippet PR + migration blurb; 5) re-run preview and re-upload any missing golden images to docs/assets/console-gallery/. Any objections?
Lee: :thumbsup: I'll re-run local preview once the revert lands and report any remaining mismatches.
eng-oncall: Noted  monitor telemetry for any unusual span errors after consumers follow the migration guide. Ping if we see anomalies.
Jamie: Thanks all  I'll update the PR description with the checklist and tracking tasks: docs#5701/revert-sanitizer, infra#docs-lint, docs#5701/snippet-sweep, assets/upload-gallery.
